title: Calculus
intro: The mathematics of continuous change, from limits and derivatives to integrals.

blocks.text: This topic is a short starter: its pages are stubs waiting to be written out.

items: Limits (#/math/calculus/limits): The foundational idea of approaching a value, underpinning both derivatives and integrals.
Derivatives (#/math/calculus/derivatives): Instantaneous rates of change and the slope of a curve at a point.
Integrals (#/math/calculus/integrals): Accumulation and area under a curve — the inverse of differentiation.
